Hi Samir — great to meet you (virtually) and thanks for the details in your note. Confirming Thu 7/17 14:30–15:00 PT for a 30-minute call — invite sent.

Agenda (30m):
- 0–5m: intros & success criteria
- 5–20m: technical integration (KV cache, latency expectations, quantization tradeoffs)
- 20–28m: pricing bands (hosted / dedicated / Private VPC options)
- 28–30m: next steps & timeline

Topline answers ahead of the call:
- Hosted vs Dedicated: for ~200M events/month, typical unit costs trend lower on Dedicated reserved capacity; we’ll show ballpark numbers and a cost-sensitivity view on the call.
- EU-only tenancy / Private deployment: we support Private (customer-managed VPC) deployments and region-specific tenancy for EU data — we’ll bring the compliance summary.

I’m attaching a one-page SOC 2 summary and a short pricing explainer so procurement has immediate context. If procurement has a preferred NDA/PO template, please share prior to the call and we’ll route to legal.

Look forward to the conversation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
